title: Kula Today
heading: Yesterday · Tue 24 Nov
summary: A flat day (forecast light). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 09:00 to about 18:30. A high day for November: the base reached about 5,800 ft (normal 4,500–5,500 ft). Yesterday evening, the page called it normal, about 5,400 ft, a miss. Midday the base averaged about 5,600 ft by the Kekoa camera, 200 ft higher than yesterday evening's number; the morning update said about 5,400 ft, off by 200 ft. Most of the day the shear line was north of Makawao; furthest south about 17:07, crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); the Mesonet could not be reached on 44 of 54 updates.
